transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, we have a 600-kilogram shipment of battery-grade graphite powder staged at receiving this morning. It's needed for the electrode-compounding run later this week, and the supplier, product description, and quantity all match the purchase order. Before we can record any disposition, our policy requires quality, logistics, and EHS to each document their current release requirements and completion status. I'd like to go around and get each of your findings so we can determine whether this gets a conditional release or a hold. Could each of you share where things stand on your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the receiving sample test this morning. Moisture came in at 0.14%, which is below our internal maximum of 0.20%. The graphite release procedure requires samples from exactly 3 locations in the shipment, and I completed that check. However, I have not yet entered the results in the electronic lot record.

transcript.text: Thanks, Eli. Good news on the moisture results. On the logistics side, I need to flag a documentation issue. I've confirmed the requirements with the broker, but I have not yet filed that exception record.
